title: The Ocean Is Deeper Than You Think

metadata.title: The Ocean Is Deeper Than You Think 🌊
metadata.description: Everest would vanish in the Mariana Trench with over two kilometres to spare. Here's how deep the ocean really goes.

beats.narration: If you dropped Mount Everest into the ocean, it would disappear.

scene.subtitle: if you dropped it in the ocean

beats.narration: Seventy one percent of our planet is water, and we have mapped less than a quarter of the sea floor in detail.
Everest stands at eight thousand eight hundred and forty nine metres. The Challenger Deep goes down almost eleven thousand.
At the bottom, the pressure is over one thousand times what you feel right now.
Down there it is pitch black, near freezing, and still full of life.
Only a handful of people have ever been there. The first in nineteen sixty.
Follow for more facts from the deep.
